changeSet.comment: Grant Quản lý đơn COD on finance roles (AD/DH/KT write, others read where applicable)
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO role_group_screen (role_group_id, screen_key, perm_level) SELECT rg.id, 'quan-ly-don-cod', CASE rg.code WHEN 'AD' THEN 'Y' WHEN 'DH' THEN 'Y' WHEN 'KT' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'R' END FROM role_group rg WHERE rg.code IN ('AD', 'DH', 'KT') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM role_group_screen s WHERE s.role_group_id = rg.id AND s.screen_key = 'quan-ly-don-cod' );
